Now I have the full picture. Let me write the shared detector/plugin first.## What happened

Chat messages wrote file paths as plain text (`./coolify-install.sh`, `src/components/Markdown.vue`) — dead ends. You asked for them to become links that open the in-app FileViewer: a new tab in desktop mode, a modal in single mode.

## What I did

- **New `client/src/utils/markdownFileLinks.js`** — the detection rule (`findFileReferences` / `splitFileReferences` / `normalizeReference`) plus `markdownFileLinks`, a markdown-it **core** rule that rewrites `text` and `code_inline` tokens into `<a class="file-link" data-file="…">` anchors. It runs after `linkify`, never touches URLs (`https://x/y.md`, `www.x/y.sh`), versions (`v1.4.0`), `$VARS`, fenced code, or existing `[label](url)` links; inline code is linked only when the whole span is the reference; `:line:col` and a leading `./` are stripped before hitting the file API.
- **`MarkdownViewer.vue`** (the renderer chat messages actually use, via Document → ChapterBlock) and **`Markdown.vue`** (global `<Markdown>`) now register the plugin and open the reference on click through one delegated handler. `addFileUploadIcons` masks the new anchors so they are never double-wrapped.
- **`store/ui.js`** — new `openFileViewer(filePath)`: desktop (`codx-junior-split`) → the existing `openFileInViewer` panel/tab path; anything else → `filePreview` state. `closeFileViewer`, plus both fields excluded from persistence.
- **New `components/filebrowser/FileViewerModal.vue`** + mount in **`App.vue`** — full-width dialog with the real `<FileViewer>` (`params.filePath`), Esc/backdrop/✕ to close, copy-path button.
- **New `client/tests/markdownFileLinks.test.mjs`** — 18 tests, including a fixture of a real answer from your history.

Evidence: `node client/tests/markdownFileLinks.test.mjs` → **all 18 passed**; `vite build` → **5266 modules transformed, exit 0**, so `dist` is rebuilt and the running client container serves the new bundle.

## Demo

Open a chat with file references in prose — e.g. the task **"review this dev docker-compose…"**, whose answer contains `./coolify-install.sh` — and look at the message: the references are underlined links; clicking one opens the FileViewer (dialog over the chat in single mode, its own tab in `/desktop`).
